mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO food_favorite (user_id, food_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{foodId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM food_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND food_id = #{foodId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM food_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND food_id = #{foodId}

SELECT FROM food_favorite favorite INNER JOIN food f ON f.id = favorite.food_id AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED' LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id WHERE favorite.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY favorite.created_at DESC

SELECT FROM food_favorite favorite INNER JOIN food f ON f.id = favorite.food_id AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED' LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id WHERE favorite.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY favorite.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM food_favorite favorite INNER JOIN food f ON f.id=favorite.food_id AND f.review_status='APPROVED' WHERE favorite.user_id=#{userId}
